name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of best-practice checklists and slash commands that make an AI coding assistant behave like a disciplined senior engineer instead of a sloppy one.
buyer: A solo developer or small startup CTO who doesn't have a senior engineer on staff to enforce code quality.
business_use_cases: A no-code-to-code bootcamp bundles it into their curriculum so students' AI-generated projects don't collapse under technical debt.
A fractional CTO installs it across every client repo as part of their engagement to instantly raise code quality.
An agency uses its /ship and /review commands as a repeatable QA gate before client delivery, replacing a manual checklist.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'fractional CTO in a box' setup service bundling this plus a short training call
Build and sell a custom industry-specific skill pack (e.g. a HIPAA-aware code review skill) as an add-on

steal_this: This weekend, package a niche add-on skill (e.g. 'HIPAA-aware code review') on top of this framework and sell it to solo devs in that space.
